Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services

Class StorageService

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services.StorageService
@Service public class StorageService extends Object
Service class for managing storage entities. Provides operations for creating, updating, removing, and querying storage entities. Interacts with the StorageRepository for persistence and query operations.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
